policy: everything not explicitly allowlisted is excluded
excluded_source_paths: all SOL or USDC checkout and value-rail modules
all token-delivery, LUMAKey issuance and redemption modules
all workspace, analytics, advisor and credit-ledger modules
all administration, support, monitoring and abuse-control modules
all private API clients and non-public route catalogs
all source maps, generated bundles and local caches

backend, database, worker or administrative execution
